description: Production readiness (real auth, approval routing, request integrity, notifications) and the HR negative-balance resolution workflow, plus administration and reporting features. Covers US-09 through US-24 of PRD-LeaveTrack-v1.0 Revision v1.1.

summary: Production fails closed on missing configuration
description: Make lib/env.ts reject a production start (NODE_ENV or APP_ENV production) without DATABASE_URL, CRON_SECRET and the auth secrets, so production can never silently use the in-memory store. /api/test/reset refuses to run in production regardless of E2E_RESET_TOKEN.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: starting a deployed environment (APP_ENV production/staging or VERCEL_ENV production/preview) without DATABASE_URL fails with a clear configuration error;AC2: the same for a missing CRON_SECRET or auth secret (auth secrets are added to REQUIRED_WHEN_DEPLOYED by TASK-023/024);AC3: /api/test/reset returns 404 in a deployed environment even when E2E_RESET_TOKEN is set;AC4: development and test still start with no .env

description: safeRedirectPath accepts '/\t/evil.com' and '/\n/evil.com', which browsers resolve to an external origin (confirmed in the EPIC 2 evaluation). Reject control characters and backslashes, resolve against a fixed origin and require the same origin.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: '/\t/evil.com', '/\n/evil.com', '//evil.com', '/\\evil.com' and absolute URLs fall back to /dashboard;AC2: normal paths with query strings are preserved;AC3: a test corpus covers every bypass form;AC4: an e2e sign-in with a malicious next lands on /dashboard

summary: Tooling: ESLint peer mismatch and coverage reporting
description: eslint@10.15.0 is outside the peer range of the eslint-plugin-import, jsx-a11y and react bundled by eslint-config-next (B9). Resolve versions from the registry: pin a compatible ESLint or document why not. Add a pinned coverage provider and a CI coverage report.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: npm ls reports no invalid peer dependency for eslint, or the exception is documented in the retro;AC2: npm run lint still passes with 0 warnings;AC3: CI publishes a coverage summary and the baseline is recorded

summary: Repository hygiene: graph cache and task-status script
description: Stop tracking graphify-out cache files (keep what the graphify conventions need), document the branch-per-task workflow, and fix the set-task-status script gaps from code review (multi-line fields, BOM, mixed line endings).
acceptance_criteria: AC1: running a graph query leaves git status clean;AC2: set-task-status handles a BOM, CRLF files and quoted multi-line fields, with tests;AC3: AGENTS.md git conventions mention the branch workflow

summary: Session port and signed session cookies
description: Introduce an auth port with a mock adapter (dev/test only) whose session cookie is HMAC-signed with SESSION_SECRET, replacing the unsigned mock-role/mock-user-id cookies. Role, manager and active status are re-read from the users table on every request. ADR-LeaveTrack-E004.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: a forged or tampered session cookie is treated as unauthenticated (API 401, pages redirect to /login);AC2: the mock adapter cannot be enabled in production;AC3: role scoping regression tests (US-03 AC3, US-04) and the full e2e suite stay green;AC4: secrets are compared in constant time (security-conventions test)

description: Add the Supabase Auth adapter: email/password sign-in, invite and password-reset flows, session refresh in proxy.ts, users.auth_user_id link (migration with pre-check). Authorization stays in the database. Versions resolved from the registry. ADR-LeaveTrack-E004.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: an invited user signs in with their own credentials and gets their database role;AC2: a provider user with no linked users row cannot access the app;AC3: sign-out revokes the session;AC4: the real flow is exercised against local Supabase (supabase start)

description: Idle timeout (default 30 minutes, configurable) plus an 8-hour absolute limit, a new session on every sign-in, and sign-in rate limiting. Fixes /login ignoring next for signed-in users (B16).
acceptance_criteria: AC1: after the idle timeout or 8 hours the next request requires sign-in;AC2: activity extends the idle window but never the absolute limit;AC3: repeated failed sign-ins are throttled;AC4: /login with an active session honours a safe next

summary: Approval routing for managers and HR Admins
description: HR Admins decide requests from their direct reports (managers) via /approvals; HR Admins without a manager are decided by another HR Admin; self-decisions are blocked in SQL and by a trigger; submission with no eligible approver returns 409; pending requests show who they await. ADR-LeaveTrack-E005.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: a manager's request appears only in their HR Admin's queue;AC2: an HR Admin's request can be decided by another HR Admin and never by themselves (403 and trigger);AC3: submitting with no eligible approver returns 409 and creates nothing;AC4: pending requests show 'Awaiting <name>';AC5: moving an employee to a new manager moves their pending requests (US-04 AC2)

summary: Overlap, maximum length and past-date rules
description: Block overlapping pending/approved requests by the same user in the database (exclusion constraint or locking trigger), enforce a 90-day maximum and allow past start dates only for Sick (at most 30 days back), in zod and in the database. Map the new constraints in toAppError.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: an overlapping request is rejected with 400 at the API and in the form;AC2: two simultaneous overlapping submissions create exactly one request;AC3: 91 days or a disallowed past start is rejected;AC4: Sick 30 days back is accepted

summary: Withdraw pending and cancel approved requests
description: Employees withdraw pending requests and cancel approved leave before its start date. New 'cancelled' status and audit action; cancelling approved leave restores the balance and writes a ledger row in the same transaction; the manager is notified.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: withdrawing a pending request sets cancelled, writes an audit row and removes it from the queue;AC2: cancelling approved future leave restores exactly its days to its own leave type;AC3: started or past leave cannot be cancelled (409);AC4: only the requester can cancel (403 otherwise)

description: Append-only balance_ledger written by every balance writer (approval, accrual; later cancellation, recovery, conversion) in the same transaction, with a unique source key. Extend the balance-writer registry test. ADR-LeaveTrack-E006.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: every balance change has exactly one ledger row whose delta and balance_after match;AC2: replaying the same source key is rejected;AC3: ledger rows cannot be updated or deleted;AC4: memory and Postgres stores stay in parity

description: notifications and notification_outbox tables written in the same transaction as the business change; bell and /notifications page; the notifier port writes the outbox instead of logging. ADR-LeaveTrack-E007.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: submit and decide write an in-app notification and an outbox row in their transaction;AC2: a rolled-back action leaves no notification;AC3: users see only their own notifications;AC4: the inbox meets the mobile and accessibility e2e checks

description: Migrations for balance_resolutions, balance_recoveries, balance_resolution_events and app_settings (resolution_response_days default 3, range 1-14), with pre-checks, CHECK constraints, the tracked-type guard, append-only triggers and a one-open-resolution unique index. ADR-LeaveTrack-E006.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: an Unpaid or untracked-type resolution is rejected;AC2: unpaid + recovery days must equal the deficit;AC3: a second open resolution for the same user and type is rejected;AC4: event rows cannot be updated or deleted;AC5: new constraints are mapped in toAppError

description: HR /resolutions page (Needs proposal, Awaiting employee, Declined - review, History), propose dialog (split, start period, months, deduction preview), service, API and server action.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: only tracked types with a balance below 0 and no open resolution are listed;AC2: invalid splits or a monthly deduction above the accrual rate are rejected;AC3: proposing writes the resolution, event and notification in one transaction with a fixed respond_by;AC4: non-HR users and HR on their own balance get 403

description: Employee resolution card (accept; decline with reason); applying clamps to the current deficit and records proposed and applied amounts; a decline returns to HR, who may re-propose once and after a second decline records a binding final decision (D6).
acceptance_criteria: AC1: accepting before the deadline applies the clamped amounts and notifies HR;AC2: declining requires a 3-500 character reason;AC3: after a second decline only a final decision is possible;AC4: responses after respond_by return 409;AC5: two simultaneous accepts apply once

description: /api/jobs/resolution-expiry (GET for Vercel Cron, POST manual; constant-time Bearer CRON_SECRET first, fail closed) converts expired proposals to Unpaid using FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED; the deadline is also enforced on every read and response.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: an expired proposal is converted and closed, and the employee and HR are notified;AC2: re-running changes nothing;AC3: an expiry racing an accept has exactly one outcome;AC4: unauthorized calls get 401 before any database access

summary: Recovery deductions in the accrual job
description: Apply each scheduled recovery inside the accrual transaction that claims the month, once per resolution and period, including catch-up; only the resolution's leave type is affected.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: each scheduled period is deducted exactly once, including during catch-up;AC2: sibling leave types are unchanged;AC3: a later policy change does not alter agreed amounts;AC4: a failure rolls back the accrual and the deductions together

description: Balance page states (negative, proposal pending with countdown, recovery schedule, converted days), dashboard banner, request annotations, and resolution events in the HR audit report.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: the employee sees the open proposal, deadline and upcoming deductions;AC2: the HR audit report lists resolution events with actor (or System), amounts and reasons;AC3: every new state passes the mobile, focus and axe e2e checks

description: Outbox dispatcher job with an email provider adapter (REST, no SDK), retries with backoff, idempotency keys; nudges for approvals pending over 3 days and resolutions 24 hours before the deadline. Closes B6; adds the missed-accrual alert from B23.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: each outbox row is emailed at least once and never twice for the same key;AC2: failures retry with backoff and never affect the business action;AC3: nudges are sent at most once per day per item;AC4: a missing accrual month by the 2nd triggers an HR alert

description: Blocked on decision D9. If business days are chosen: a holidays table managed by HR and a countDays replacement used by submit, balances and decisions, with a migration plan for existing requests.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: the chosen rule is recorded in the PRD;AC2: every day count (form, balance, decisions, ledger) uses the same rule;AC3: existing requests keep their recorded day counts

description: HR edits accrual rates with an effective month; leave_policy_versions keeps history; accrual uses the rate in effect for each period. Answers the ARCH open question on mid-year changes (B24).
acceptance_criteria: AC1: HR can change a rate effective from a future or current month;AC2: catch-up accrual uses the rate in effect for each missed month;AC3: every change is audited with actor and timestamp;AC4: untracked types cannot receive a policy

description: HR edits operational settings (resolution response days 1-14, idle timeout, maximum request length) with validation and audit; values apply only to new proposals, sessions and requests.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: out-of-range values are rejected;AC2: each change is audited;AC3: changing the response deadline does not alter open proposals

description: Replace script-src 'unsafe-inline' with a per-request nonce (B10); add Postgres-backed rate limits for sign-in, submit and decisions (B17).
acceptance_criteria: AC1: no inline script runs without the nonce and the full e2e suite stays green;AC2: exceeding a limit returns 429 in the error envelope;AC3: limits hold across server instances

summary: RLS policies and real Supabase verification
description: Add RLS policies matching the app's scoping (B7) and run migrations plus a smoke suite against real Supabase in CI (B12).
acceptance_criteria: AC1: every table has RLS policies and a direct anon query cannot read other users' data;AC2: CI applies all migrations to a real Supabase instance;AC3: the smoke suite (sign-in, submit, decide, accrual) passes there

description: HR Admin manages users: invite, role, manager, active status (no hard delete). Guards: at least one HR Admin, no self-demotion, no manager cycles. Every change audited (B25 UI fallback for new leave types included).
acceptance_criteria: AC1: role, manager and active changes take effect on the user's next request;AC2: removing the last HR Admin, self-demotion or a manager cycle is refused;AC3: deactivated users cannot sign in and their pending approvals are reassigned;AC4: every change is audited

description: Profile page; password change through the provider with re-authentication.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: changing the password requires the current password;AC2: other sessions are signed out after a password change;AC3: the page passes the mobile and accessibility e2e checks

description: pending_email_changes: the user requests, HR approves, the new address is verified, then the sign-in email changes. Each step is audited and notified.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: the email does not change until HR approves and the new address is confirmed;AC2: HR sees pending changes in a queue;AC3: a rejected request leaves the email unchanged and notifies the user

description: TOTP MFA with QR enrolment, mandatory for HR Admins and optional for others; optional emailed one-time code sign-in.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: an HR Admin cannot reach the app without a verified TOTP code;AC2: enrolment shows a QR code and recovery guidance;AC3: one-time codes expire and are single use

description: Theme choice stored in a cookie and applied server-side (no flash, no new dependency); .dark tokens in hsl; role accent tokens. Closes B11.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: light, dark and system themes render without a flash;AC2: WCAG AA contrast and zero serious axe violations in both themes;AC3: role accents never convey meaning by colour alone

description: Usage by type and month and balance trends from the ledger, scoped in SQL to own, direct reports or organisation; inline SVG charts with accessible tables.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: each role sees exactly its scope, proven by scope tests;AC2: charts have text alternatives and work at 320px;AC3: figures match the ledger exactly

description: Month grid of approved and pending leave for the viewer's scope; list view on mobile; keyboard operable.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: scope matches role (own, direct reports, organisation);AC2: keyboard and screen-reader operable;AC3: no horizontal overflow at 320 and 375px

description: URL-driven filters for requests, approvals and audit with keyset pagination on (occurred_at desc, id). Closes B21.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: filters combine and are reflected in the URL;AC2: pagination is stable under concurrent inserts;AC3: manager scoping stays in SQL (structural test)

description: HR exports filtered audit and request data as streamed CSV; cells starting with = + - @ are escaped; exports are audited.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: the export matches the filtered rows;AC2: formula-injection characters are neutralised;AC3: only HR Admins can export and each export is audited

description: Add a Playwright WebKit project with an iPhone profile to cover Safari date inputs, viewport units and focus behaviour (B22).
acceptance_criteria: AC1: the mobile e2e specs pass on WebKit;AC2: CI caches the WebKit browser

summary: README, architecture overview and ADR sign-off
description: Complete README: prerequisites (Node per .nvmrc, Supabase CLI, Docker for supabase start, Playwright browsers), frontend/backend architecture, environment variables, migrations runbook, running every check. Record the Docker decision (npm retained) and track ADR E002-E007 sign-off.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: a new developer can run the app, tests and e2e from the README alone;AC2: every environment variable in .env.example is documented;AC3: each ADR shows its sign-off status
